# Instructions live in CLAUDE.md

`../CLAUDE.md` is the single instruction surface for every agent and every editor here. It is one
screen and points at the page each task needs.

Every page is listed in [../docs/index.md](../docs/index.md): rules in `docs/rules.md`, the
measured laws of pricing in `docs/laws.md`, mistakes already paid for in `docs/traps.md`, what to
run in `docs/runbook.md`.

This file held a second copy until 2026-09-03 and drifted. Do not refill it.
